snippet.title: NEW Presto! Trailer Version 0.2
snippet.description:
Hey guys,

We've been quiet on our front but busy squirreling (or monkeying? in this case) away behind the scenes with a new update for Presto!
Version 0.2 fixed some bugs users were having and added original music and SFX. We hope you're all enjoying the playtest on Steam, which we aim to keep updated throughout development.

Please check the FREE game out on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4312200/Presto/?beta=0

And follow us along for updates on our socials:
https://linktr.ee/circuscatstudios
